name: Raw pu-erh tea (sheng)
definition: post-fermented Yunnan large-leaf tea left to age naturally (sheng), loose or pressed into cakes, tuo cha or bricks.

name: Ripe pu-erh tea (shou)
definition: Yunnan large-leaf tea fermented by wet-piling to speed ageing (shou, shu), loose or pressed into cakes, tuo cha or bricks.

name: Jasmine tea
definition: tea, usually green or white, scented with jasmine blossoms, sold loose, as pearls or tuo cha.

name: Blooming tea
definition: tea leaves hand-tied around flowers into a bulb that unfurls when steeped, sold as single bulbs or sets.
